beats.say: The 50‑year‑old snooker legend suffered a shocking defeat.
You might think The Rocket always breezes through early rounds.
But in Belfast, world No 110 qualifier Cheung Ka Wai knocked him out.
He lost to Cheung Ka Wai in the opening round of the Northern Ireland Open.
Snooker crowd gasps as the upset unfolds.
He’s a seven‑time world champion, a record that few can match.
Will you still back The Rocket after this surprise loss?

meta.title: Ronnie O'Sullivan stunned by qualifier 😲
meta.summary: The 50‑year‑old seven‑time world champion Ronnie O'Sullivan was knocked out of the Northern Ireland Open by world No 110 qualifier Cheung Ka Wai, showing even legends can suffer surprise defeats.
meta.comment: Did you expect The Rocket to lose to a world No 110 qualifier?

es.title: Ronnie O'Sullivan atónito ante un clasificado 😲
es.summary: El heptacampeón mundial Ronnie O'Sullivan de cincuenta años fue eliminado del Abierto de Irlanda del Norte por el clasificado número ciento diez del mundo Cheung Ka Wai demostrando que hasta las leyendas sufren derrotas sorpresivas.

pt.title: Ronnie O'Sullivan chocado por qualifier 😲
pt.summary: O heptacampeão mundial Ronnie O'Sullivan de cinquenta anos foi eliminado do Aberto da Irlanda do Norte pelo qualifier número cento e dez do mundo Cheung Ka Wai mostrando que até lendas sofrem derrotas surpreendentes.

hi.title: Ronnie O'Sullivan क्वालीफायर से हैरान 😲
hi.summary: पचास वर्षीय सात बार के विश्व चैंपियन Ronnie O'Sullivan को Northern Ireland Open में दुनिया के सौ दसवें नंबर के क्वालीफायर Cheung Ka Wai ने बाहर कर दिया जिससे साबित होता है कि दिग्गजों को भी चौंकाने वाली हार मिल सकती है।
